scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w bloglist-backend && npm run test -w bloglist-frontend
scripts.test:e2e: concurrently -n backend,frontend,playwright -c blue,green,yellow "npm run start:test -w bloglist-backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run test -w playwright" --kill-others -s first
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w bloglist-backend && npm run lint -w bloglist-frontend
